title: Comparative Effects of Fish Oil Supplementation and a Montelukast on EIB and Airway Inflammation in Asthma

sections.abstract: Combining fish oil supplementation and Montelukast \[a commonly used cyst LT1 receptor antagonist to treat exercise-induced bronchoconstriction (EIB)\] will provide a greater antiinflammatory effect against developing EIB that either agent alone
